file_description: Field Production by Formation and Well Vintage - Monthly oil/gas production and water/gas/CO2 injection data grouped by field, geological formation, and well vintage (first production date)
data_format: LONG format - one row per company-field-formation-vintage-month combination
priority: HIGH - Critical for OPGEE modeling (water injection, CO2-EOR, formation-level analysis)
use_case: Calculate WOR, WIR, gas injection ratios, CO2-EOR operations, track production by well vintage and formation, reservoir characterization

field_descriptions.oil_production_m3: Total oil production in cubic meters for wells of this vintage in this formation during the month
field_descriptions.gas_production_km3: Total gas production in thousand cubic meters (km3) for wells of this vintage in this formation during the month
field_descriptions.water_production_m3: Total water production (produced water) in cubic meters - includes formation water and injected water breakthrough
field_descriptions.water_injection_m3: Total water injected in cubic meters - for waterflooding, pressure maintenance, or disposal
field_descriptions.gas_injection_km3: Total gas injected in thousand cubic meters (km3) - for gas flooding, pressure maintenance, or gas cycling
field_descriptions.co2_injection_m3: Total CO2 injected in cubic meters - for CO2-EOR (enhanced oil recovery) operations
field_descriptions.other_injection_m3: Other fluid injection in cubic meters - may include nitrogen, polymers, or other EOR fluids
field_descriptions.formation_name: Geological formation/reservoir name - critical for reservoir characterization and production modeling
field_descriptions.well_vintage_year: Year when wells in this cohort first started production - enables decline curve analysis by vintage
field_descriptions.well_vintage_month: Month when wells in this cohort first started production
field_descriptions.resource_type: Type of hydrocarbon resource: Conventional (traditional reservoirs) or Unconventional (tight oil/gas, shale)

unit_notes.oil_production_m3: Cubic meters (m3) - monthly total for this field-formation-vintage group
unit_notes.gas_production_km3: Thousand cubic meters (km3 = 10^3 m3) - monthly total. To convert to Mm3: divide by 1000
unit_notes.water_volumes_m3: All water volumes (production and injection) in cubic meters (m3)
unit_notes.co2_injection_m3: CO2 injection in cubic meters at standard conditions
unit_notes.gas_conversion_scf: km3 to scf: multiply by 35,314.7 (since 1 km3 = 1000 m3, and 1 m3 = 35.3147 scf)

calculated_metrics.wor_water_oil_ratio: water_production_m3 / oil_production_m3 - Critical OPGEE input for water treatment energy
calculated_metrics.wir_water_injection_ratio: water_injection_m3 / oil_production_m3 - Indicates secondary recovery intensity
calculated_metrics.gor_gas_oil_ratio: (gas_production_km3 * 1000) / oil_production_m3 - Gas-to-oil ratio in m3/m3 (convert to scf/bbl for OPGEE)
calculated_metrics.gir_gas_injection_ratio: (gas_injection_km3 * 1000) / oil_production_m3 - Gas injection per barrel of oil produced
calculated_metrics.co2_injection_ratio: co2_injection_m3 / oil_production_m3 - CO2 injected per barrel for EOR
calculated_metrics.water_injection_fraction: water_injection_m3 / (water_injection_m3 + water_production_m3) - Fraction of water cycled
calculated_metrics.net_water_production: water_production_m3 - water_injection_m3 - Net water requiring disposal
calculated_metrics.field_age_at_production: year - well_vintage_year - Age of well cohort at time of production (for decline analysis)
calculated_metrics.is_secondary_recovery: water_injection_m3 > 0 OR gas_injection_km3 > 0 - Binary flag for enhanced recovery
calculated_metrics.is_co2_eor: co2_injection_m3 > 0 - Binary flag for CO2 enhanced oil recovery

data_quality_validation.zero_production_check: Rows with zero oil AND zero gas production may indicate injection-only wells or data errors
data_quality_validation.injection_without_production: Water/gas injection without corresponding production may indicate pilot testing or data issues
data_quality_validation.negative_values: All production and injection values should be >= 0. Negative values indicate data errors.
data_quality_validation.unrealistic_ratios: WOR > 50 or WIR > 10 may indicate data quality issues or extreme recovery scenarios
data_quality_validation.formation_consistency: Formation names should be consistent within a field. Check for spelling variations.
data_quality_validation.vintage_validation: well_vintage_year should be <= production year. Future vintages indicate data errors.
data_quality_validation.co2_presence: CO2 injection should correlate with known CO2-EOR projects. Unexpected CO2 values warrant investigation.

technical_notes.well_vintage_concept: Wells are grouped by their first production date (vintage). Enables tracking production decline by cohort age and formation.
technical_notes.formation_importance: Different formations have vastly different production characteristics. Critical for reservoir modeling and OPGEE inputs.
technical_notes.water_injection_purpose: Water injection used for: (1) Waterflooding (secondary recovery), (2) Pressure maintenance, (3) Produced water disposal
technical_notes.gas_injection_purpose: Gas injection used for: (1) Gas cycling, (2) Pressure maintenance, (3) Gas flooding EOR
technical_notes.co2_eor_operations: CO2 injection indicates enhanced oil recovery operations. Requires CO2 source tracking for carbon intensity.
technical_notes.wor_evolution: WOR typically increases over field life as water cut rises. Critical for operating cost and emissions modeling.
technical_notes.secondary_recovery: High water or gas injection relative to production indicates secondary/tertiary recovery operations.
technical_notes.produced_water: Includes both formation water and breakthrough of injected water. Requires energy-intensive treatment/disposal.
technical_notes.decline_curve_analysis: Tracking production by vintage enables decline curve fitting and EUR (estimated ultimate recovery) calculations.
technical_notes.conventional_vs_unconventional: Unconventional resources (Vaca Muerta shale) have steeper decline curves but respond differently to EOR.

data_integration.join_key: field_id + year + month - can aggregate to field level by summing across formations and vintages
data_integration.formation_rollup: Sum across all formations and vintages to get total field production (compare with other production files)
data_integration.vintage_rollup: Sum across all vintages to get total production by formation
data_integration.cross_validation: Total production (summed) should match totals in oil_field_production and gas_field_production files
data_integration.time_series_by_vintage: Track individual vintage cohorts over time to model decline curves
data_integration.opgee_aggregation: For OPGEE, typically aggregate to field level but retain formation mix for reservoir modeling

opgee_critical_inputs.wor_calculation: WOR = water_production / oil_production - Critical for water treatment energy calculations in OPGEE
opgee_critical_inputs.wir_calculation: WIR = water_injection / oil_production - For secondary recovery modeling
opgee_critical_inputs.water_treatment_energy: Higher WOR means more produced water requiring separation, treatment, and disposal (energy intensive)
opgee_critical_inputs.water_injection_energy: Water injection requires pumping energy proportional to WIR and injection pressure
opgee_critical_inputs.gas_flooding_indicator: gas_injection_km3 > 0 indicates gas flooding operations (affects gas balance in OPGEE)
opgee_critical_inputs.co2_eor_carbon_intensity: CO2 injection for EOR has major CI implications. Need to track CO2 source (natural vs anthropogenic).
opgee_critical_inputs.secondary_recovery_flag: Fields with injection operations have different energy profiles than primary recovery
opgee_critical_inputs.formation_specific_parameters: Different formations may have different API gravity, GOR, pressure, temperature - affects OPGEE inputs

use_cases.wor_wir_calculation: PRIMARY USE - Calculate water-oil ratio and water injection ratio for OPGEE modeling
use_cases.formation_characterization: Understand which formations contribute most to production and their characteristics
use_cases.vintage_decline_analysis: Track production decline by well cohort age - enables forecasting and EUR estimation
use_cases.secondary_recovery_identification: Identify fields using waterflooding, gas flooding, or CO2-EOR
use_cases.water_management: Calculate net water production requiring disposal vs water recycled via injection
use_cases.co2_eor_tracking: Identify and quantify CO2-EOR operations for carbon intensity assessment
use_cases.reservoir_modeling: Formation-level production data enables multi-layer reservoir modeling
use_cases.operator_benchmarking: Compare WOR, WIR, and recovery efficiency across operators and basins
use_cases.production_forecasting: Use vintage-based decline curves to forecast future production

limitations.aggregated_by_vintage: Data aggregated across all wells of same vintage in same formation. Individual well data not available.
limitations.formation_name_variations: Formation names may have spelling variations or inconsistencies. Requires cleaning.
limitations.no_injection_well_counts: Shows injection volumes but not number of injection wells
limitations.no_pressure_data: Injection pressures not provided - important for energy calculations
limitations.gas_unit_mismatch: Gas in km3 while oil/water in m3. Requires unit conversion for ratio calculations.
limitations.other_injection_undefined: Other injection type not specified - could be nitrogen, polymer, or other EOR fluids
limitations.monthly_aggregation: Monthly totals may mask intra-month variability in injection operations

typical_values.wor_primary_recovery: 0.1-2.0 for primary recovery. WOR increases over field life.
typical_values.wor_secondary_recovery: 2.0-20.0 for mature waterflooded fields. Can exceed 50 in late life.
typical_values.wir_waterflooding: 0.5-3.0 typical for waterflooding operations. Varies with recovery efficiency.
typical_values.gor_oil_fields: 50-500 m3_gas/m3_oil typical for associated gas. Higher for gas condensate.
typical_values.co2_injection_eor: 0.3-0.6 m3_CO2/m3_oil typical for CO2-EOR projects at steady state
typical_values.gas_injection_cycling: Gas cycling projects may inject 80-95% of produced gas
typical_values.conventional_argentina: Most Argentina production is conventional (Neuquina basin)
typical_values.unconventional_vaca_muerta: Vaca Muerta (unconventional) has lower WOR initially but steeper decline
typical_values.major_formations: Key formations: Vaca Muerta, Quintuco, Mulichinco, Agrio, Troncoso, Barrancas

example_analysis.calculate_wor_python: wor = water_production_m3 / oil_production_m3 if oil_production_m3 > 0 else None
example_analysis.calculate_wir_python: wir = water_injection_m3 / oil_production_m3 if oil_production_m3 > 0 else None
example_analysis.calculate_gor_python:
gor_m3_m3 = (gas_production_km3 * 1000) / oil_production_m3 if oil_production_m3 > 0 else None
gor_scf_bbl = gor_m3_m3 * (35.3147 / 6.28981)  # Convert to scf/bbl

data_timeline.end_date: Check last row for most recent data
data_timeline.well_vintages: Wells first production dates range from early 2000s to present
data_timeline.historical_coverage: Captures production from wells drilled over 15+ year period

quality_checks.formation_name_cleaning: Standardize formation names (lowercase, remove special characters, handle common variations)
quality_checks.vintage_plausibility: Check that well_vintage_year <= production year and well_vintage_year >= 2000 (or earlier for old fields)
quality_checks.production_injection_balance: For closed systems, cumulative injection should be similar to cumulative production over time
quality_checks.zero_value_interpretation: Zero injection is normal (primary recovery). Zero production with injection indicates injection-only operations.
quality_checks.co2_project_verification: Cross-reference CO2 injection with known CO2-EOR projects in Argentina
